NamikazeOS OneISO boot tree
===========================

tree: armhf
loader: uboot

Artifacts supplied by the kernel build pipeline (dist/ inputs):
  boot/armhf/boot/armhf/zImage
  boot/armhf/boot/armhf/initrd.img
  boot/armhf/boot/armhf/rootfs.img
  boot/armhf/boot/armhf/dtbs

Boot entries whose files are absent are hidden by the bootloader,
so this tree degrades gracefully on any given machine.
